trigger_examples: RE; resume this research project; continue prior staged research; recover project state
required_modules: 00 + 08 + 07; then task modules only if a separate task is present
routing_note: Recover structured canonical state first; validate against registered artifacts; consult archived conversation evidence only if needed; respect Seen Data boundaries; RE alone stops after recovery.

trigger_examples: AU; audit the current research workflow; trace the earliest material gap
required_modules: 00 + 08 + 07 + modules actually used by the current workflow
routing_note: Audit already-performed work and return the earliest material gap or inconsistency. AU alone does not advance the research state.

trigger_examples: form a research question; screen candidate research problems; define actor/construct/estimand/so-what
routing_note: Apply question/contribution governance without forcing empirical or AI-specific modules.

trigger_examples: literature search; focused census; collision screening; novelty/contribution adjudication; L4
routing_note: Run literature/collision workflow; use source-quality and collision-evidence gates; do not load AI profile for ordinary finance/accounting research.

trigger_examples: research design; identification; measurement design; pilot/screen/formal design; model/estimator choice
routing_note: Classify the empirical execution class and run method precedent/identification requirements before outcome-bearing execution.

trigger_examples: raw data; data QA; cleaning; merging; variable construction; missing data; outliers; panel build
routing_note: Use assistant-first execution where host capabilities permit; preserve raw identity and blind-data boundaries.

trigger_examples: optional effect-open outcome decision screen; resource-allocation screen; screen failure diagnosis
routing_note: OUTCOME_DECISION_SCREEN is resource-allocation only. Freeze screen rules and reuse policy before effect open. Formal SESOI/equivalence/economic-null adjudication belongs to FORMAL_STUDY.

trigger_examples: formal main estimation; run frozen primary specification; formal economic-threshold adjudication
routing_note: Requires Freeze B formal main specification and formal identification. Run frozen estimation/result QA before mechanism, robustness, or writing claims.

trigger_examples: data access; WRDS; Bloomberg; LSEG; paid/private research databases; API/bulk entitlement
routing_note: Platform existence is not entitlement or scalable research access. Search lawful construct-preserving alternatives before declaring access blocked.

trigger_examples: research on AI/LLMs/agents/automation in finance, accounting, insurance or related business domains
routing_note: Load AI × Finance only as an explicit specialization profile. It must not redefine ordinary finance/accounting research.

trigger_examples: human-subject experiment; expert labeling; task benchmark/evaluation; marginal workflow value; cost-quality design
routing_note: Load specialized gates only when the design actually uses them.

trigger_examples: write research results from frozen evidence; claim ceiling; evidence-to-claim mapping
routing_note: Use frozen evidence and claim ceiling. This is research-writing governance, not general prose polishing.

trigger_examples: automatic before claiming a task complete/PASS or handing off a formal result
required_modules: 00 + 07 + 08 + modules used by the current task
routing_note: Use LIGHT closure for ordinary tasks and MILESTONE validation for formal freezes/results/releases. Do not confuse a defined contract with observed host execution.
